spans.s: Lunar,Ⓒa.ⒹcAMdra (drI f.), cAMdramasa (sI f.), sOmya, EMdava (vI f.); gen. ex. by caMdra-soma- in comp.; ‘l(unar) month’ cAMdramAsaH; ‘l(unar) race’ caMdra-soma-vaMSaH; ‘l(unar) day’ tiTi m. f.; ‘l(unar) mansion’ nakzatraM; ‘l(unar) eclipse’ caMdroparAgaH.

Lunatic,Ⓒa.Ⓓunmatta, sonmAda, vAtula, BrAMta-citta-mati-budDi, vikziptacitta, hata-nazwa-budDi; ‘a l(unatic) asylum’ vAtulAlayaH.
ⓃLunacy,Ⓒs.ⒹunmAdaH, budDi-mati-BraMSaH, cittavikzepaH-viplavaH, vAtulatA, mati-budDi-BramaH.
